forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Circular dependencies make architecture harder to reason about.

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: Orphan modules may indicate dead code or missing public exports.

forbidden.name: no-deprecated-core-to-runtime
forbidden.comment: Core/query packages must not depend on runtime/session/execution layers.

forbidden.name: no-core-to-dialects
forbidden.comment: Core/query/AST layers must not depend on SQL dialect implementations.

forbidden.name: no-dialect-to-runtime
forbidden.comment: Dialect packages should render SQL and avoid depending on runtime execution.

forbidden.name: no-tests-in-production
forbidden.comment: Production code must not import test code.

forbidden.name: no-src-cross-package-relative-imports
forbidden.comment: Packages should not import other packages through relative filesystem paths. Use workspace package names.

forbidden.name: no-private-package-internals
forbidden.comment: Avoid importing another package internal files directly. Import from its public entrypoint.

forbidden.name: no-any-in-internal-api-files
forbidden.comment: This is a weak signal only. Use TypeScript/ESLint for strict any enforcement.
